name: Zhang Yiming

lifetimeGiving.source: Announced donations only: 500M CNY (2021) + 200M CNY (2023) to Fangmei Education Development Fund, Longyan; approx 700M CNY (~USD 0.1B) total announced. No published lifetime figure found.

foundation.name: Fangmei Education Development Fund (Longyan, Fujian) - a local government-administered education fund, not a private foundation

onTheRecord.finding: Donated 500 million yuan (about USD 77M) in June 2021 to set up the Fangmei Education Development Fund in his hometown Longyan, Fujian, named after his grandmothers; announced during the post-crackdown 'common prosperity' charity wave among Chinese tech founders.
Longyan Education Bureau announced May 2023 an additional 200 million yuan (about USD 28.9M) donation to the same fund.

notes: Forbes profile (real-time, 9/20/26) shows $84B, #25 in world, residence Singapore, citizenship China; no Forbes philanthropy score displayed on profile page. Not a Giving Pledge signatory (no entry seen; full-list check not performed within budget - treat as needs-check). No private foundation with public financials; the Fangmei fund is administered locally in Longyan and does not publish reports accessible in this search. Yahoo/SCMP also report a donation with cofounder Liang Rubo of about USD 28M to Nankai University (not independently verified here). Amounts in CNY; USD conversions as reported by press at the time.
